newsitem.title: USA: Seaman gets $24/shr offer for 20 pct stake.
newsitem.headline: Seaman gets $24/shr offer for 20 pct stake.

text.p: Seaman Furniture Co Inc said Wednesday it received an offer from its senior management and majority shareholders to buy the remaining 20 percent in the company that they do not own for $24 a share.

The group, which includes M.D. Sass Associates Inc, T. Rowe Price Fund LP and Carl Marks Management Co, currently holds an 80 percent stake in the company and the offer is one that seeks to turn the company private, said Peter McGeough, a Seaman official.

Seaman, in a statement, said the group's proposal is subject to certain conditions, including obtaining acceptable financing and the negotiation of mutually agreeable terms of a definitive merger agreement.
Seaman said it has named a special committee of independent directors to review and respond to the proposal. The committee is empowered to hire financial and legal advisers, it said.
Seaman, the largest specialty retailer of furniture in the Northeast, operates a chain of 41 stores in New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Connecticut and Ohio.
